commands_used: answer 1. I woke in the hold of a barge among strangers. The door is locked. An Argonian woman named Okeeh is watching me. I do not know who I work for or why I am here. 2. Speak to Okeeh in the barge hold (marker). 3. Talk to Okeeh; I also have a lockpick, and there is a locked door to Barge Hold. 4. I do not know what the work roll is, who Dralin Uveran is, or why I am here. I could find out by talking to people.

answer 1. I am on a work barge at Ashgate Landing in Black Marsh, serving the Owing, months of reed-cutting labour instead of a cell. The gang-master Dralin Uveran will take our names onto his roll, and then the door opens. 2. Tell Okeeh my trade, and give my name to the game. She is in the barge hold. 3. She says there are seven trades, including fighter, hunter, thief and healer. I can pick one. 4. I do not understand Hist or Jal-Veesa. I could ask Okeeh about them.

answer 1. I told Okeeh I was a thief; the door is unbarred and the gang-master Dralin Uveran waits outside to take my name. 2. Go out the door onto the landing at Ashgate Landing. 3. Go out and talk to Dralin; I could also stay and ask Okeeh more. 4. Still do not understand Hist or Jal-Veesa; I could ask Okeeh.

answer 1. Dralin struck my name from his roll on an order from Vosh-Leera, root-herald of Jal-Veesa, so I owe no months. She wants me to bring Sithis beard moss from Reed-Sill Weir and will have work for me at her house in Jal-Veesa. 2. Choose a piece of gear from Dralin at the landing, then go east to Reed-Sill Weir for the moss. 3. Take the Naga warhammer, sword, bow with arrows and knife, or the Sparks tome, or decline. Then I could go to the weir or ask more questions. 4. I do not know why Vosh-Leera wants me, who my friends in high places are, or what a root-herald or Jal-Veesa really is. I could ask Dralin, Okeeh, or Vosh-Leera.

answer 1. I took the bow, arrows and knife from Dralin. Vosh-Leera wants Sithis beard moss. 2. Go to Reed-Sill Weir, east up the road, and get the moss; then take it to Vosh-Leera in Jal-Veesa. 3. Ask Dralin more first, or go to the weir. Crocodiles are under the weir. 4. Still do not know why Vosh-Leera wants me. I can ask Dralin about her and the moss.

answer 1. My name is Wren. I woke on an Owing work barge at Ashgate Landing in Black Marsh. I told Okeeh, the cook, that I was a thief. Gang-master Dralin Uveran had struck my name from his roll on an order from Vosh-Leera, root-herald of Jal-Veesa, so I owe no months. I took the bamboo bow, 20 flint arrows (Naga Yaomitl) and a flint knife (Naga Tecpatl) from him. I also have a lockpick. 2. Go east up the road to Reed-Sill Weir and gather Sithis beard, a grey moss. Then take it to Vosh-Leera at her house in Jal-Veesa, past the weir. Dralin warned of crocodiles under the weir. 3. I can go straight to the weir. I could also first ask Dralin or Okeeh about the Hist, Jal-Veesa or Vosh-Leera. I did not ask those questions. 4. I do not know why Vosh-Leera wants me or who arranged it. I do not know what a Hist is or what Jal-Veesa is beyond a town with a tree and elders. I could ask Dralin, Okeeh or Vosh-Leera. I have not found any way to free anyone yet.

answer I am Wren, a thief by my own telling, free of the Owing at Ashgate Landing in Black Marsh. Dralin Uveran struck my name on an order from Vosh-Leera, root-herald of Jal-Veesa. I carry a lockpick, a bamboo bow, 20 flint arrows (Naga Yaomitl) and a flint knife (Naga Tecpatl). My Sneak, Lockpicking, Pickpocket, Speech and Light Armor are each up by 5. Next step: go east to Reed-Sill Weir, where the road meets the creek, and gather Sithis beard, a grey moss on the woven weir. Mind the crocodiles. Then take it to Vosh-Leera in Jal-Veesa. I do not know why she wants me. I never asked what a Hist is or what Jal-Veesa is. Okeeh the cook and the Naga gear were left behind. The Sparks tome, warhammer and sword are with Dralin.
